[[Category:Recipes for dessert]]

== Ingredients ==
* 5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] semisweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], roughly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]], divided
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]], beaten
* 1 habanero [[Cookbook:Chiles|chilli]], seeded and minced
* 12 wheat flour [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]], each cut into 10 wedges
* ½ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] juice
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] tortilla wedges with butter. Sprinkle with ¼ cup sugar and place on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|half-sheet pan]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|375°F]] for 15 minutes. Remove and set aside.
#Heat an inch of water in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]]. Place a stainless steel bowl that hangs over the edges on top to make a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].
#Remove bowl from pot and add egg yolks, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisking]] continuously, and place back on top of the pot. Cook, whisking continuously, until eggs fall off of whisk in a ribbon.
#Add chocolate, chilli, orange juice, remaining sugar, and vanilla extract. Cook, whisking continuously, until chocolate is melted and all ingredients are heated through.
#Drizzle sauce over tortillas, and serve warm.

steps.text: Toss tortilla wedges with butter. Sprinkle with ¼ cup sugar and place on a half-sheet pan.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Heat an inch of water in a large saucepan to a simmer. Place a stainless steel bowl that hangs over the edges on top to make a double boiler.
Remove bowl from pot and add egg yolks, whisking continuously, and place back on top of the pot. Cook, whisking continuously, until eggs fall off of whisk in a ribbon.
Add chocolate, chilli, orange juice, remaining sugar, and vanilla extract. Cook, whisking continuously, until chocolate is melted and all ingredients are heated through.
Drizzle sauce over tortillas, and serve warm.
